answer: Resist sybils with a posted work bond plus a similarity gate. When an identity submits, it locks 500 POA until the next checkpoint. The bond is released only if at least five established graders score the text 2 or higher; it is slashed to the grader pool if a majority scores 0 or 1, or if Jaccard overlap of 5-word shingles with any other key's answer exceeds 0.85. A farm then pays 500 POA per puppet and still cannot reuse text. I would post that rule on the settlement beacon by the garden path, where juniper and yarrow mark the boundary between cheap copies and work that keeps its stake.
